components.name: tab-bar-ios
components.description: Tab bar is a top-level navigation control for iOS apps.

extensions.notes: iOS uses 'highlighted' state for pointer interactions on devices with pointer support (iPad with mouse/trackpad)
differences: Only available on iOS devices with pointer support

extensions.notes: iOS uses UIFocusSystem for keyboard and pointer navigation
differences: Supports both keyboard and pointer navigation
Property is named 'isEnabled' but inverted (false = disabled)
Affects both visual appearance and interaction

extensions.notes: iOS uses isSelected for toggle-able controls
differences: Used for toggleable controls like checkboxes and radio buttons
Can be combined with other states (highlighted, disabled)

documentBlocks.content: Tab bar is a top-level navigation control for iOS apps. See https://spectrum.adobe.com/page/tab-bar-ios/ for full usage guidance.
